title: Real Estate ERP – Margins Developments
problem: Margins Developments managed all real estate sales, reservations, broker commissions, and contract data through disconnected spreadsheets. Leads were lost, commissions were miscalculated, and there was no reliable pipeline visibility for management.
solution: I designed and built a complete Odoo ERP system from scratch — covering CRM, unit management, reservations, broker tracking, contracts, accounting workflow, and payment milestone tracking. The system replaced every spreadsheet with structured, automated workflows.
features: Real Estate CRM with lead qualification pipeline
Unit / Property catalog with availability and pricing
Payment milestone tracking with automated reminders
QWeb PDF reports (contracts, receipts, unit sheets)
impact: Eliminated data silos across sales, reservations, and accounting. Management gained real-time pipeline reporting, brokers gained a structured commission workflow, and the operations team went from weekly manual spreadsheet consolidation to automated daily reporting.

title: Engineering ERP – DOTec Engineering
problem: DOTec Engineering tracked active projects, consultant assignments, and client engagements manually. No centralized system existed for managing multi-discipline engineering teams (civil, structural, MEP, robotics, forensic) across concurrent client projects.
solution: Built a full internal Odoo ERP from scratch — covering engineering CRM, project lifecycle management, multi-discipline team management, timesheet and expense tracking, document management, automation, and comprehensive QWeb reporting.
features: Role-based access control and security groups
impact: Gave DOTec real-time visibility into project status, consultant utilization, and financials across all active engagements. Eliminated manual project tracking, reduced administrative overhead, and provided management with actionable operational data.

title: Government Digital Platforms – EjadTech
problem: Government and public-sector clients required digital transformation ERP backbones for large-scale national platforms — including a Ministry of Environment agriculture platform (Zeraei), a Ministry of Media platform (VRO), and a regional emirate participation platform (Tasharuk).
solution: As an Odoo Developer on EjadTech's delivery team, I contributed to ERP/business workflow modules across these projects — building custom module development, backend logic, automation workflows, access rights, QWeb reports, and integration support.
features: Backend logic and ORM data models
impact: Supported national-scale digital transformation initiatives for Saudi government ministries and regional authorities, contributing reliable ERP workflow modules to high-visibility public sector platforms.

title: Multi-Client ERP & BPM – EJAD Digital Solutions

features: CRM pipeline automation and HR customization
Security groups and access rights configuration
Code review and module quality improvements
impact: Delivered clean, production-grade Odoo ERP solutions across concurrent client projects at an official Odoo Silver Partner — while contributing to a landmark AI visitor service project for one of the world's most significant sites.
